eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: New Jersey; at 9:25 AM on AUG 27, 2016 Effective until 10:25 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THE NEW JERSEY STATE POLICE IS ACTIVATING THE AMBER ABDUCTED CHILD ALERT PLAN. THE SUSPECT WAS LAST SEEN OPERATING  2004 SILVER HYUNDIA ELANTRA  BEARING PENNSYLVANIA REGISTRATION HKB4681.
